claim: 같은 약관은 ULD 운송의 중량을 "용기와 내용물의 실중량과 부피 중량 중 큰 값"으로 정의해 ULD 자중이 들어가는 구조를 보여 줍니다.
evidence: CTA sample tariff Rule 1 (https://otc-cta.gc.ca/eng/publication/tariff-transportation-cargo-between-points-canada-and-points-outside-canada): '"Gross Weight" means the actual or volume weight whichever is greater, of the container plus contents.' This is the tariff's general Gross Weight definition, not a definition of 'ULD 운송의 중량'; the same Rule 1 also defines '"Net Weight" means the total gross weight of a container less the tare weight of the container' and '"Tare Weight" means the weight of the empty container including its normal complement of restraint devices.' The sample tariff has no ULD rating rule saying tare is charged. Whether ULD tare is included in or deducted from chargeable weight is set by each carrier's ULD/BUP rate conditions (Lufthansa Cargo only refers to the pivot weight 'published in TACT, Chapter 8 ... under 3.10.5 "Bulk Unitization Charges"': https://www.lufthansa-cargo.com/documents/d/guest/rate-and-price-conditions). Not supportable as a general rule.
fix: 같은 약관은 실중량(Gross Weight)을 "용기와 내용물을 합친 실중량과 부피 중량 중 큰 값"으로, 순중량(Net Weight)을 "용기 총중량에서 용기 자중(tare)을 뺀 값"으로 따로 정의합니다. ULD 자중을 운임 중량에 넣는지 빼는지는 항공사의 ULD 요율 조건이 정하므로 함께 확인합니다.
